jurisdiction.venue: Hong Kong SFC, AFRC & High Court of Hong Kong

headline: PwC Pays $167 Million to Put Evergrande’s Audits Behind It; Evergrande’s Liquidators Present an $8.4 Billion Tab
deck: Hong Kong’s S.F.C. and A.F.R.C. imposed HK$1.3 billion in combined sanctions and a six-month public-interest audit ban in April, while liquidators press an $8.4 billion High Court lawsuit.
byline: By The Financial Crimes Asia Bureau

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: HK$1.3B (~$167M) combined regulatory package (HK$300M AFRC fine + HK$1B SFC fund) plus a 6-month PIE audit ban — 1.99% of liquidators’ $8.4B claim.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Certifying $1,800 in nonexistent collateral on a consumer credit application
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Criminal fraud charges rather than a six-month timeout on new public-interest clients
